title: How to Improve Visibility Across Your Enterprise AI Ecosystem
summary: This article addresses the critical security gap where AI adoption in enterprises has outpaced governance and monitoring capabilities, leaving organizations vulnerable because they cannot protect what they cannot see. Traditional security monitoring tools are inadequate for tracking AI activity, necessitating new strategies for security teams to regain visibility and control over their AI ecosystems.
problem_solved: The lack of visibility into enterprise AI systems that creates security vulnerabilities and governance gaps.
why_valuable: It highlights the foundational importance of AI visibility as a prerequisite for all other security controls, helping organizations prioritize monitoring before incidents occur.
